LESSON: SUBTRACTION

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.4: Subtraction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Subtraction. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-105.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 105]]

From your pupil's book (page 105)

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-109.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 109]]

From your pupil's book (page 109)

TERM 2 Week 6 Lesson 4 Subtract and add Activity Write addition as subtraction + 1 = 6 Write as 6 - 1 = 5 6 - 5 = 1

1. 3 + 4 = 7 7 - 3 = 7 - 4 = 2. 2 + 6 = 8 8 - = 2 8 - = 6

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-163.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 163]]

From your pupil's book (page 163)

NUMBERS SUBTRACTION Week 5 Lesson 1 Subtract

Activity What is 11 take away 5? - 5 = Count 5 steps back from 1 1 to get to 6

11 - 5 = 6 Work to do 1. What is 1 2 take away 7?

5. Tom had 1 5 chicken. He sold 8 chicken. How many chicken were left?

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Subtraction means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Subtraction.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Subtraction
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
